claims.summary: A reusable isolated-Chrome runner now drives the product runtime and registry, hashes the exact cached public base, records operating-system memory, and retains four byte-bound device artifacts with fail-closed trace privacy checks and no model weights in Git.

Chrome 150 on Apple M4 Max with 48 GiB unified memory passed the frozen Apple-Silicon load, completion, memory, activation, rollback, recovery, repeat, and artifact requirements with the retained measured timings.

The retained run observed a network-aborted public-base download, exact full-digest recovery, separate-adapter cache eviction and redownload, real Chrome GPU-process restart, old-runtime inference failure, and successful reload completion.

The exact smoke adapter verified and activated at scale 16, changed deterministic inference, cleared natively, and restored the exact base and project digests; future runtime proof callers also receive the native status already bound into the proof hash.

The semantic audit accepts exactly the Apple-Silicon run and remains blocked on the other three profiles; the smoke adapter is non-promotable and creates no educational-quality, held-out, paid-reference, B/A, or public-adapter claim.
